## Independence and exact basis

Formal-lifecycle/manual, bounded delegated review. This separate distribution-delivery-reviewer authored neither the primary plan nor its governing models. Parent distribution-plan-author authored the plan/correction; distribution-design-author authored the upstream package. Reviewer writes only review evidence and its own finding disposition. The complete revised primary plan was reread, including all milestones, groups, procedures, commands, checkpoints and risks.

Fresh CLI subject inspection confirms the approved ten-member Design package, proposal-review-r3/design-review-r5, retained source/proof obligations and command-feasibility basis remain unchanged since the first Delivery pass; only the primary plan and author evidence changed among relied-on subjects. Previous complete/targeted basis reads remain applicable. Exactly the registered primary plan is the delivery subject; models/test specs are basis, not extra delivery members. Prior delivery-review retains its original changes-requested judgment and subject; its finding origin is preserved.

## Implementation readiness and verification adequacy

Safe sequencing and intermediate states: pass. M1 isolates real two-parent anchored relocation and outside-discovery preservation before public force dispatch, with old-consumer regression protection and a stop if no supported success path can be realized. M2 coherently changes public installer, two-target generation, metadata and Release consumers. M3 establishes replacement detection before mirror/check retirement. M4 removes precisely the mapped fifteen sources and reconciles real consumers after behavior/protection exist. Each milestone has scoped recovery and independent Code Review dependencies; no partial target-list change is presented as coherent completion.

Requirement-to-proof trace: pass. DIST-SR-01–20 and reciprocal owner requirements map to M1–M4, TG-01–08/TG-FINAL-01/02 and C1–C10/E1–E3. Actual filesystem success, unsupported capabilities, ancestor/source races, new public arrivals, open-handle writes, outside-discovery retention, symlink/access faults and partial retry have M1 proof. M2 adds real public default/force, both targets/acquisition paths, complete no-write conflict preflight, obsolete-file removal, state irrelevance, removed syntax/target, archive/hash/count/path and privacy proof. M3 and M4 cover resource/selector and current-source/historical-reader boundaries.

Retained maintenance policy: pass after correction. TG-08 provides explicit R14–20/R22 applicability, scoped admission records, representative dual proof before deletion and four actual measurement categories. Unknown fixture behavior stops affected retirement. Approved withdrawn behavior is identified as de-contracted rather than required to succeed in replacement tests. E1/E2 close with the changing milestone; E3 begins with the pre-change M1 baseline and completes with M3/final scope reconciliation. No other initiative's exception is silently applied.

Oracle and command credibility: pass. Independent expected bytes/counts, real archive and packed CLI observations, deterministic barriers and actual supported filesystem primitives can expose the claimed failures. Mocks may inject faults but may not replace the successful primitive or validator. Named retained runners exist; the first-pass inspection confirmed Node discovery, explicit-path CI and the imported real candidate fixture invoking prepared-candidate release verification. C1 is transparently proposed; parameterized commands require exact expanded execution evidence. E2 isolates original-source runs from this repository's installed skills. E3 records reproducible scope/timing limitations without a savings threshold. No execution is claimed by naming a command.

Change-level proof and closeout: pass. TG-FINAL-01/02 assess the composed archive/installer/resource/selector/source-retirement path after later milestones and consume TG-08 outputs. Reuse requires explicit unchanged-surface/identity reasoning and reruns when later changes invalidate it. Fresh independent final whole-change Code Review follows all four implementation milestones and corrections, separately preceding distinct Verify. Milestone review or group non-applicability cannot waive this checkpoint.

Authority, compatibility and recovery: pass. Project state remains untouched and irrelevant, retained originals stay outside discovery and require separate cleanup authority, obsolete current OpenCode paths reject, and historical released facts retain their original population. The plan neither changes the approved force safety contract nor authorizes publication/customer installation. Additional semantic or source-deletion scope returns to the owning Design. Failed proof stops the affected milestone instead of silently changing its acceptance criteria.

## Finding disposition

Independently reread the complete revised primary plan. TG-08/E1 now allocates every affected script/check's R14 admission fields, current justified reuse and gate ownership with milestone completion requirements. E2 requires actual old/replacement representative accepted/rejected proof before deletion, names isolated exact pre-removal mirror-source execution and C3/C5 replacement paths, applies the same discipline to M2, and records source/fixture identities, results, coverage differences, approved decontractions and rollback. E3 allocates actual before/after command counts, elapsed runtime, changed-line totals and maintenance owners with baseline timing, scope/environment/run-count limitations and final reconciliation. Requirements mapping, M1–M3 completion criteria and TG-FINAL-02 consume the outputs. This satisfies the original R14/R19/R22 allocation finding without an inventory-wide rewrite, per-test ledger system or implicit waiver.

## Evidence limitations and recording

Current author evidence distribution-plan-retirement-correction records passing plan prose, scoped lifecycle and whitespace checks. C1–C10 and E1–E3 are future implementation/manual evidence procedures, not executed runtime proof. The 33 unchanged legacy prose errors remain explicitly failed baseline evidence; this approval neither calls them passed nor waives Verify's treatment. No implementation work or public operation was performed for this review.

Review record: docs/changes/2026-09-10-distribution-model-and-opencode-retirement/reviews/delivery-review-r2.json. Original finding disposition: reviews/delivery-review.json, dist-delivery-retirement-allocation. This fresh approval is current only for the exact plan and unchanged upstream basis. Return to Route; recording alone does not begin implementation or settle work state.
